exposure: Transcatheter intra-arterial methotrexate infusion combined with UAE (UAE+MTX)
cohort: 33 women with cervical ectopic pregnancy (CEP) treated at a single hospital between 2009 and 2016
finding: Triple therapy of transcatheter intra-arterial methotrexate infusion combined with uterine artery embolization followed by immediate curettage was a feasible and advantageous treatment option for cervical ectopic pregnancy, resulting in faster recovery and fewer complications compared to systemic methotrexate or uterine artery embolization alone.
